entities.name: Thallid
entities.description: Fungus creatures created by infusing fungus with green mana, farmed as cattle to produce saprolings.

entities.name: Sarpadia
entities.description: Place where thallids were created after the Sylex Blast.

entities.name: Sylex Blast
entities.description: Event after which Sarpadian food sources dwindled.

entities.name: Thelon
entities.description: Elven druid who infused fungus with green mana to create thallids.

entities.name: Order of the Ebon Hand
entities.description: Group whose methods and thrulls were used in making thallids.

entities.name: Kolevi
entities.description: Elder druid with whom Thelon shared the secret of thallid origins.

entities.name: Lalani
entities.description: Elder druid with whom Thelon shared the secret of thallid origins.

entities.name: Elves
entities.description: Sarpadian elves who farmed thallids and were eventually overrun.

entities.name: Thrulls
entities.description: Creatures of the Ebon Hand who coexist with thallids.

entities.name: Icatia
entities.description: Sarpadian empire destroyed with thallid help.

entities.name: Sporoloth
entities.description: Fungus creatures resembling thallids that appeared from the future during the Time Spiral crisis.

entities.name: Slimefoot
entities.description: Thallid grown from a spore on the Weatherlight, an unofficial member of Jhoira's crew.

events.summary: Thelon creates thallids by infusing fungus with green mana.
events.quote: infused the fungus with green mana to create a living creature that produced saprolings

events.summary: Thallids gain sentience and the elves split over destroying or aiding them.
events.quote: The elves would be split into two factions

events.summary: The elves are overrun by their creations.
events.quote: would eventually be overrun by their creations

events.summary: Thallids help orcs, goblins and thrulls destroy Icatia.
events.quote: Thallids would assist the orcs , goblins , and thrulls in destroying Icatia

events.summary: Slimefoot grows from a spore on the Weatherlight and joins the crew.
events.quote: became an unofficial member of Captain Jhoira 's crew

relations.quote: unofficial member of Captain Jhoira 's crew
